notes: Company summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (B2B) with an in-app conversational assistant for product managers and a support augmentation layer for CS agents.
Hosted trial: ran for 12 weeks with ~8k MAU; trial traffic skewed to daytime business hours (09:00-17:00 ET).

Measured traffic (hosted trial): avg QPS 1.2, peak observed QPS 6, concurrency spikes to ~40 during product pulse emails; token mix observed: 70% generation, 25% embeddings (semantic search), 5% lightweight reranking calls.

Token profile (trial telemetry): median prompt tokens ~70, median completion tokens ~240, end-to-end avg tokens per request ~310. Embedding calls are smaller (~64 tokens) but frequent for session search prefetch.
Latency SLO desire: 95p generation latency <300ms for chat interactions; embeddings <100ms if possible for interactive search UX.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market, team expects committed pricing to be ~2x cheaper than hosted list for predictable unit economics; interested in committed burst windows.

Dedicated sizing ask: forecast for 6-month growth (5x traffic). Current hosted trial baseline -> recommend sizing for sustained peak QPS ~30 and burst concurrency ~200 to cover growth + provisioning buffer.
Suggested config from SE notes: 8-12 GPU workers with continuous batching + prefix cache for active sessions; separate embedding workers (CPU or lower-GPU) for cost efficiency. SE: Marcus Lee.
Routing/fallback: want automated fallback to smaller quantized variants during capacity shortage; need per-route model pinning (agent vs. prod assistant).
Security: require SAML SSO, customer-managed KMS for key wrapping, audit log retention 1 year, and option for EU data residency for a subset of customers.
Legal: procurement asks SOC2 Type II report and executed DPA; legal prefers a 12-month committed term with quarterly usage review.
Quote request: asked for 12-month committed capacity sheet, breakout for base + burst pricing, and options for stopgap credits if usage spikes above commit.
Customer quote: 'We like the hosting performance but need a predictable bill for our 2 commercial tiers — trial showed good latency but burst days are painful.'
POC plan: two-week Dedicated POC with traffic replay from hosted logs (de-identified) + smoke test for KMS and VPC peering. Need red-team review window from security (2 weeks).
